limits: One process/configuration and evolving windows; no statistical stability or universal winner claim.
CPU measurements overlapped the separate NPU correctness qualification; other users were not excluded. Host load and physical mappings are recorded.
FP32 PDG strict complete-record failures remain failures; their times are ineligible for equivalent-speed claims.
Python2.12/CANN9.1 and standalone SDK2.10/CANN9.0 are different complete execution choices, not an isolated language-only comparison.
Small resident profile has a vendor capture-cycle warning; medium profiles explicitly complete the cycle. Inclusive/overlapping durations are not additive.
All timed cases are FP32, single-device, widths4/32 and full-support sending; no large-model, sparse-routing, cross-card, FP16 throughput or CUDA-hardware claim.
No isolated runtime/loader cold-start timing or standalone allocator peak; construction/warmup and whole-process elapsed are separately reported.
